interview.message: The public playbook connects transactional collection pages, schema, internal links, Reddit authority, and measurement. Revenue is the organizing principle.
One workspace for each Shopify client: research, assess, prioritize, coordinate, QA, and review. SEOasis is the agency example here; collection and revenue frameworks apply to its clients.
interview.step: How I understand the operating model

interview.message: A bounded public sample surfaces specific validation tasks. I separate what the HTML proves from what only Search Console or client access could establish.
Create a repeatable release QA pack, test commercial-page discovery, and validate the intent roles of nearby service pages. Confirm scope and baseline before execution.
Which query/page combinations convert? Which collections have sufficient products, margin, and stock? What attribution rules and delivery capacity should govern the plan?
Use impact × confidence ÷ effort as a transparent starting point. Then apply dependencies, catalog economics, and capacity. Scores support judgment; they do not replace it.
interview.step: How I would prioritize client work

interview.message: Baseline and align, ship a small high-confidence batch, measure and QA it, then expand or revise. Every account gets a visible next action and a quarterly decision.

This work sample demonstrates research, organization, technical implementation, and documented decisions. I would bring the same discipline to your methodology, learn quickly, and make fulfillment easier to scale.
